scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && mvn -q compile dependency:build-classpath "-Dmdep.outputFile=target\runtime-classpath.txt" && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$deps = Get-Content 'target\runtime-classpath.txt'; java -cp ('target\classes;' + $deps) com.digitallostfound.server.Server"
